value: Sources/SeaBearKit/Extensions/ViewExtensions.swift — Three concerns mixed in one file: (1) `.clearNavigationBackground()` with iOS 18/17 branch — since 2026-07-17 BOTH branches hide scroll content backgrounds: iOS 18 = containerBackground(for: .navigation) { Color.clear } + .scrollContentBackground(.hidden) (both required, see context.ios18_list_opacity); iOS 17 = toolbarBackground(.hidden) x2 + scrollContentBackground(.hidden). (2) `.adaptiveInnerBorder(color:cornerRadius:)` luminance-aware highlight (light colors get dark top edge, dark colors get light top edge — luminance>0.7 threshold), (3) UIWindow shake-detection plumbing + `.onShake(perform:)` (iOS only, posts on `UIDevice.deviceDidShakeNotification`).
